label: report
definition: What comes back when delegated work stops: the name of the work and its outcome first, then what is done, what waits for a yes, the numbers before and after, what failed or is risky, the open questions and the next step. A builder's report carries the PR URL; cckit orchestrate --results collects a wave's.
is_not: A brief: the brief goes out to the builder; the report comes back.
A status: cckit status reads the repository now; a report records one run.
A PR body: the PR body is for the reviewer; the report is for the person who delegated.
